identity.name: Dynamic DNS Domain Access via PowerShell
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a payload from a dynamic DNS domain, triggering a recurring rare domain access alert. Cortex should detect the unusual network activity and process
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a payload from a dynamic DNS domain, triggering a recurring rare domain access alert. Cortex should detect the unusual network activity and process behavior.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Recurring Rare Domain Access
biocs.description: Detection of repeated access to a dynamic DNS domain not seen in the environment
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_protocol = ENUM.TCP
| filter dst_port = 80
| comp count() by action_remote_ip, actor_process_image_name
| filter count > 1

abiocs.name: PowerShell Download and Execute from Dynamic DNS
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation of PowerShell downloading and executing from a dynamic DNS domain
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name like '%powershell.exe%'
| filter action_file_path like '%malware.exe%'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
abiocs.causality_anchor: powershell.exe process start with download and execute

xql_queries.name: Detect Rare Dynamic DNS Access
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| comp count() by action_remote_ip, actor_process_image_name
| filter count > 1
